title: Watch_Dogs® 2

anticheat.note: anti-cheat present; Linux/Proton support does not extend to macOS — userspace path works for some titles

provenance: Reported by Picksley (highball-db#409, 2026-10-08), Apple M4, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.10, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r21, the environment in DXMT mode, rated 4 of 5 after 2 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on DXMT, the default mode, over a 2-minute session, with a few stutters. Ubisoft Connect's overlay stayed on screen claiming the graphics drivers are outdated, and online play didn't work, which the reporter put down to the anti-cheat. No measurement here yet.

knownIssues.symptom: Ubisoft Connect's overlay stays on screen saying the graphics drivers are outdated

knownIssues.cause: the game's Easy Anti-Cheat, per the reporter. Its support for Proton on Linux doesn't extend to Wine on a Mac.
